title: console.aurit.us has no DNS but docs and CDK callbacks use it
description:
**Problem**
The docs and the backend's OAuth callback list use https://console.aurit.us, which has no DNS record. Auritus-web uses hear.aurit.us for the same purpose, so the two repositories disagree about the console hostname.

**Evidence**
- site/app/docs/security/google-workspace/page.tsx:77 and :328
- cdk/stacks/backend.py:509-517 (callback and login URLs)
- `dig +short console.aurit.us` returns nothing (2026-10-20).

**Fix**
Decide the real console hostname, then make the docs, the CDK callbacks and Auritus-web agree, and create the DNS record.

**How to verify**
`dig +short <hostname>` returns a record, and `grep -rn 'console.aurit.us' site cdk` matches the chosen name.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
